headline: West Alabama win at UAH, AUM and Trevecca in turn
dek: Between them the three hosts have lost seven of their 50 matches, and West Alabama account for three of the seven. The run is not the end of their season: West Alabama travel again on Friday, and Trevecca, the last of their hosts, are at home on Sunday.
displaced_by: The standing lines called Trevecca v West Alabama the season's final match, but the match list now has West Alabama at North Georgia on 13 November and Trevecca at home to Francis Marion on 15 November.

pattern.text: West Alabama's goals have not bought a matching record: they have conceded 31, more than any other programme, and won nine of their nineteen matches.
